settings.general.language.desc: Language of the panel and of manager messages.
settings.general.ownerPlayer.desc: Your in-game name; used as the default target for follow and go-to-player.
settings.general.panel.bind.desc: Interface the web panel listens on. Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you need access from another PC.
settings.general.panel.port.desc: TCP port of the web panel.
settings.general.panel.openBrowser.desc: Open the panel in the default browser when the manager starts.
settings.general.link.bind.desc: Interface the bot link listens on. Change only when bots run on another PC.
settings.general.tray.desc: Show an icon in the system tray with quick actions and warnings.
settings.general.autoStartBots.desc: Start every enabled bot that has 'auto start' when the manager starts.
settings.general.eventLogLimit.desc: How many recent events the panel can show; the file keeps more.
settings.runtime.minecraftVersion.desc: Client version; must match the server.
settings.runtime.fabricLoader.desc: Fabric Loader installed for the bot clients.
settings.runtime.headlessmcVersion.desc: Launcher used to run clients without a window.
settings.runtime.headlessmcUrl.desc: {version} is replaced by the HeadlessMC version.
settings.runtime.headlessmcSha256.desc: Expected digest of the launcher jar; empty skips the check.
settings.runtime.fabricInstallerUrl.desc: Installer jar HeadlessMC uses for the one-time Fabric install.
settings.runtime.javaPath.desc: Path to a Java 25 'java' executable. Empty uses the manager's own Java.
settings.runtime.mods.desc: Mods installed into every bot. The BaritoneBots mod is always added.
settings.runtime.mods.name: Name
settings.runtime.mods.url.desc: Direct link to the jar (or use a Modrinth project).
settings.runtime.mods.modrinth.desc: Project slug; the Fabric build for the Minecraft version is chosen automatically.
settings.runtime.mods.version.desc: Preferred Modrinth version number; the newest compatible one is used when it is not listed.
settings.runtime.mods.sha512.desc: Expected digest; Modrinth digests are used automatically.
settings.runtime.startStaggerSec.desc: Pause between bot starts so they do not load at the same time.
settings.runtime.priority.desc: CPU priority of bot clients; below normal keeps your PC responsive.
settings.runtime.restart.enabled.desc: Start a bot again when its client exits unexpectedly.
settings.runtime.restart.maxPer10Min.des: After this many crashes in 10 minutes the bot stays stopped.
settings.runtime.memoryPreset.desc: Heap per bot: eco 768 MB, normal 1024 MB, performance 2048 MB, or custom.
settings.runtime.memoryMb.desc: Heap per bot when the preset is 'custom'.
settings.runtime.jvmArgs.desc: Added to every bot's Java command line, separated by spaces.
settings.runtime.gcThreads.desc: Parallel garbage collector threads per bot.
settings.runtime.maxHeavyTasks.desc: How many bots may mine, explore, farm or build at the same time (0 = no limit).
settings.servers.desc: Minecraft servers the bots play on.
settings.servers.name: Name
settings.servers.autoConnect.desc: Join the server as soon as the client starts.
settings.servers.reconnect.enabled.desc: Reconnect after a kick or a lost connection.
settings.servers.reconnect.maxDelaySec.d: Upper limit of the reconnect delay.
settings.servers.login.loginCommand.desc: {password} is replaced by the bot's password.
settings.servers.login.registerCommand.d: {password} is replaced by the bot's password.
settings.servers.login.loginPatterns.des: Regular expressions for chat lines asking to log in.
Regular expressions for chat lines asking to register.
settings.servers.login.successPatterns.d: Regular expressions for successful login lines.
settings.servers.login.failurePatterns.d: Regular expressions for failed login lines.
settings.servers.login.joinCommands.desc: Sent once logged in, one per line.
settings.servers.companion.enabled.desc: The server runs the optional BaritoneBots companion plugin.
settings.servers.companion.token.desc: Must match the plugin's token; stored in secrets.json.
settings.servers.protection.enabled.desc: Never break the listed blocks or anything inside protected zones.
settings.servers.protection.zones.desc: Extra zones as JSON [{dim, box}]; zones from the world page are added.
settings.servers.baritone.desc: Baritone settings for bots on this server.
settings.bots.desc: Bot accounts managed by this PC.
settings.bots.id.desc: Short unique name; also the folder name.
settings.bots.account.type.desc: Offline: any name on offline-mode servers. Microsoft: log in once with the bot's 'Microsoft login' button (device code); HeadlessMC keeps the account in the bot's folder.
settings.bots.serverId.desc: Server profile this bot plays on.
settings.bots.autoStart.desc: Start with the manager when 'Start bots with the manager' is on.
settings.bots.memoryMb.desc: Heap for this bot; empty uses the memory preset.
settings.bots.jvmArgs.desc: Added after the global extra arguments.
settings.bots.homeWaypoint.desc: Waypoint used by the 'Go home' step; empty means 'home'.
settings.bots.roles.desc: Work this bot may take; empty means any.
settings.bots.behaviour.desc: JSON merged over the global behaviour settings.
settings.bots.baritone.desc: Baritone settings for this bot only.
settings.bots.autopilot.desc: Autopilot settings for this bot only, e.g. {"supply": false, "foodMin": 16}. Keys: supply, sort, idleWork, discovery, foodMin, blocksMin, toolMinDurability, stuckSec.
settings.autopilot.supply.desc: Before a task starts, bots fetch the right tool, food, throwaway blocks and materials from storage by themselves.
settings.autopilot.sort.desc: Idle bots empty inbox chests into category chests; storage chests adopt the category most of their contents belong to.
settings.autopilot.idleWork.desc: Idle bots collect finished furnaces, load furnaces with ores from storage and walk home.
settings.autopilot.discovery.desc: Bots scan for chests, barrels, furnaces and crafting tables around them and look inside unknown ones.
settings.autopilot.discoveryRadius.desc: How far around a bot containers are looked for.
At most one scan per bot this often (and only after it moved, or every 10 minutes).
settings.autopilot.inspectMaxAgeMin.desc: Containers whose contents were seen longer ago are opened again by an idle bot (0 = only never-seen ones).
settings.autopilot.maxInspectPerTick.des: How many inspection jobs (up to 8 nearby containers each) are offered per planner tick.
settings.autopilot.homeRadius.desc: New chests and barrels this close to a home waypoint become storage; farther ones are marked 'found'.
settings.autopilot.useFound.desc: Also take items from containers found outside the home area (careful on shared servers).
settings.autopilot.foodMin.desc: Below this many food items a bot fetches food (up to twice this) before long tasks.
settings.autopilot.blocksMin.desc: Below this many blocks for pillaring and bridging a bot fetches more before mining or exploring.
settings.autopilot.toolMinDurability.des: A tool with less durability left than this share counts as worn out and is replaced from storage.
settings.autopilot.stuckSec.desc: No movement and no progress this long while a task runs: cancel, step back, retry once, then fail with 'stuck' (0 = off).
settings.autopilot.idleHomeSec.desc: An idle bot walks to its home waypoint after this long without work.
settings.autopilot.throwaway.desc: Item patterns bots carry for pillaring and bridging.
settings.autopilot.smeltInputs.desc: Items idle bots load into free furnaces from storage.
settings.autopilot.categories.desc: List of {name, globs}; globs are item patterns or #tags. The first matching category wins, everything else goes to 'misc'.
settings.autopilot.categories.name: Name
settings.autopilot.categories.name.desc: Lowercase id used in the container role sorted:<name>.
settings.orders.desc: Keep items in stock: [{id, serverId, item, min, max, into, enabled}]. Below min, bots haul, mine, craft or smelt until max (or min) is in the 'into' containers.
settings.orders.enabled.desc: Disabled orders are kept but not worked on.
settings.orders.serverId.desc: Server profile whose containers and bots the order uses.
settings.orders.min.desc: Below this stock the order becomes active.
settings.orders.max.desc: An active order fills up to this (empty = up to the minimum).
settings.orders.into.desc: Container role (storage, supply, kit, fuel, inbox, sorted:<category>) or a container id.
settings.behaviour.defense.mode.desc: What to do when a hostile mob comes close.
settings.behaviour.defense.radius.desc: React to mobs within this distance.
settings.behaviour.defense.fleeBelowHeal: Run away instead of fighting below this health.
settings.behaviour.defense.avoidNamePatt: Regular expressions matched against entity names.
settings.behaviour.defense.retaliatePlay: Treat a player who hits the bot as hostile.
settings.behaviour.deathRecovery.enabled: After respawning, walk back and pick the items up.
settings.behaviour.deathRecovery.maxDist: Skip recovery when the death point is farther away.
settings.behaviour.deathRecovery.timeout: Give up after this long (items despawn after 5 minutes).
settings.behaviour.inventoryFullFreeSlot: Free slots left when the inventory counts as full.
settings.behaviour.lowToolDurability.des: Warn when the held tool has this fraction of durability left (0-1).
settings.behaviour.pickupRadius.desc: Collect dropped items within this distance.
settings.baritone.desc: Baritone settings for all bots (name → value). Defaults are a low-load set.
settings.client.lowPower.desc: Force minimal graphics options and cap the game loop.
settings.client.skipRender.desc: Do not render frames at all (headless bots).
settings.client.renderDistance.desc: Chunks requested from the server; lower saves memory and CPU.
settings.status.activeIntervalTicks.desc: How often a busy bot reports its status (20 ticks = 1 s).
settings.status.idleIntervalTicks.desc: How often an idle bot reports its status.
settings.planner.tickSec.desc: How often the planner assigns project work to idle bots.
settings.planner.roleSwitchCooldownSec.d: A bot keeps its role at least this long.
settings.planner.maxBuildersPerSector.de: Bots building in one sector at once.
Slots left free when taking materials.
settings.planner.autoDepositWhenFull.des: When a task stops because the inventory is full, unload into storage and retry (up to 50 times).
settings.planner.depositKeep.desc: Item patterns that stay in the inventory when unloading into storage.
event.bot.crashLoop: {bot}: crashed {max} times in 10 minutes, not restarting
event.task.depositRetry: {bot}: inventory full during {task}, unloading into storage and retrying ({n})
event.recovery.tooFar: {bot}: death point is {dist} blocks away (limit {max}), items not recovered
waiting.offline: Waiting for the bot to be online
waiting.heavy_limit: Waiting for a free heavy-task slot
error.busy: The manager is busy, try again.
error.bad_json: The request is not valid JSON.
error.not_linked: The bot is not connected to the manager.
error.timeout: The bot did not answer in time.
error.wrong_server: The bot plays on another server.
error.bad_text: Chat text must be 1-256 characters on one line.
error.bad_payload: Payload must be a JSON object.
error.field.missing_source: Set a URL or a Modrinth project
settings.runtime.gameDataPath.desc: Client jar (or a folder with data/) to read recipes, tags and block drops from. Empty = the game jar under runtime/mc/versions.
settings.servers.antiXray.desc: How the server hides ores (Paper anti-xray). With hide or fake, bots mine ores the legit way.
error.bad_status: Not possible in the project's current state.
error.not_loaded: Game data is not loaded yet.
event.stuck.retry: {bot}: {task} made no progress for {sec} s; stepping back and retrying
event.stuck.failed: {bot}: {task} is stuck again after a retry; giving up
event.autopilot.manual: {bot}: {task} needs {items}, which no container has; get them by hand
event.autopilot.home_auto: {bot}: no home waypoint on this server, set home at {x} {y} {z} ({dim}); containers around it count as storage
event.autopilot.sortFull: Inbox at {x} {y} {z}: no room for {items}; add or free category chests
event.order.blocked: Standing order {item} is blocked: {items} must be added by hand
kind.build.desc: Build a schematic: the footprint is split into sectors, builders restock from supply chests, missing materials are hauled, mined, crafted or smelted.
kind.gather.desc: Bring item quotas into storage: bots haul, mine, craft or smelt until each count has arrived (counted from the stock at start).
kind.clear.desc: Dig out a box or named area: split into slabs (one per bot), each cleared with 'selection clear', drops go into storage.
kind.farm.desc: Harvest and replant a field in rounds of 'farm', then deposit the harvest; runs until stopped (or for a number of rounds).
kind.ranch.desc: An animal pen: breed up to the maximum, slaughter down to 'keep' when full, shear sheep, deposit the loot; repeats every interval.
kind.sort.desc: Sort inbox chests into the category chests (once, or continuously).
kind.smelt.desc: Load furnaces with inputs and fuel from storage and bring the results back (once until the inputs are used up, or continuously).
pfield.fuel: Fuel (empty = coal and other known fuels)
settings.servers.dayStart.desc: Local time (HH:MM) when 'day' schedules fire. Bots do not report the world time yet, so day and night follow this clock.
settings.schedules.desc: Steps queued at set times: [{id, name, when, botIds, steps, priority, enabled, serverId}]. 'when' is a 5-field cron ('*/30 * * * *'), 'day' or 'night'.
settings.schedules.name: Name
settings.schedules.enabled.desc: Disabled schedules are kept but never fire.
settings.schedules.serverId.desc: Only bots of this server profile (empty = any server).
settings.schedules.when.desc: Cron 'minute hour day month weekday' (e.g. '0 * * * *' hourly, '*/30 6-22 * * *'), or 'day' / 'night' (when it starts).
settings.schedules.botIds.desc: "any" (one free bot), "all" (every online bot) or a list of bot ids.
settings.schedules.steps.desc: Tasks and manager steps like in a scenario, e.g. [{"type":"sort_storage"}].
settings.schedules.priority.desc: Normal: runs after the bot's current project batch. High: replaces project work right away.
settings.rules.desc: If → then: [{id, name, if, then, botIds, cooldownSec, priority, enabled, serverId}].
settings.rules.name: Name
settings.rules.enabled.desc: Disabled rules are kept but never fire.
settings.rules.serverId.desc: Only this server profile (empty = any server).
settings.rules.botIds.desc: "any", "all" or a list of bot ids. Bot events and 'healthBelow' run on that bot.
settings.rules.cooldownSec.desc: Minimum time between two firings (per rule and bot / server).
settings.rules.priority.desc: Normal: runs after the bot's current project batch. High: replaces project work right away.
event.microsoft.code: {bot}: open {url} and confirm code {code} to log in with Microsoft
event.microsoft.okRename: {bot}: logged in with Microsoft as {account}, but the bot's username is {username}; change it to match
error.login_required: Log in with the Microsoft account first.
error.not_installed: The runtime is not installed yet.
error.not_microsoft: The bot does not use a Microsoft account.
task.goto.arg.pos: Where (a position or reference: home, where I stand, where I look…)
step.trash.title: Throw away junk / store surplus
step.trash.arg.to: Where to (drop, store = into storage, trash_chest = the 'trash' chest)
step.resolve.title: Find the place
settings.general.commandPrefix.desc: Owner messages starting with this prefix (e.g. "!b come") are commands for the bots, in public chat or whispered to a bot (/msg Bot1 !b come).
settings.general.ownerChatPatterns.desc: Regexes with the groups name and msg for system chat lines (chat plugins, private messages). The empty group (?<dm>) marks a private message. Signed chat is recognised without them.
settings.general.ownerReplyCommand.desc: How a bot whispers back; {player} = your name, {text} = the reply.
settings.autopilot.signWords.desc: A word on a sign at a chest → role (storage, inbox, kit, supply, fuel, trash) or category (sorted:wood). Words of 4+ letters also match longer words. Roles set by hand are never changed by signs.
settings.autopilot.autoTrash.enabled: Throw junk when the inventory is full
settings.autopilot.autoTrash.enabled.des: When the inventory fills up while mining or clearing, the bot throws junk away on the spot and goes on instead of walking to storage.
settings.autopilot.autoTrash.junk.desc: Item globs that may be thrown away (minecraft:dirt, minecraft:*_seeds…).
Glob → count the bot keeps (e.g. 64 cobbled deepslate for scaffolding).
settings.keepProfiles.desc: Name → what a bot keeps when it cleans its inventory: armor (worn), weapon (best = best sword), tools (best of each kind: pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, shears), food {max}, blocks {globs, count}, extra (globs always kept). Duplicate tools and everything else are surplus.
event.ref.failed: {bot}: could not find the place for {task}: {message}
event.trash.auto: {bot}: inventory full, throwing junk away ({items} items, {stacks} stacks)
event.task.trashRetry: {bot}: inventory full during {task}, throwing junk on the spot, then retrying ({n})
error.ref_no_owner: No online bot sees the owner (or the owner name is not set).
error.ref_no_look: You are not looking at a block within 64 blocks.
error.ref_no_home: There is no home waypoint yet.
error.ref_wrong_dim: The reference points into another dimension.
owner.reply.commands: Commands ({p} …): here <name>, home, pos1, pos2, area <name>, chest <role>, come, follow, stop, build <schematic> [rotation], farm, ranch, trash [store|chest], progress <tier>, obtain <item> [n]; @bot or @all picks the bots.
owner.reply.notSeen: I can't see you — come closer to the bots.
owner.reply.noLook: Look at the block (within 64 blocks) and repeat the command.
owner.reply.noCorners: Mark the corners first with pos1 and pos2.
owner.reply.notContainer: That is not a chest or other container.
owner.reply.badRole: Unknown role "{role}". Try storage, inbox, kit, trash or a category (ores, wood, food…).
owner.reply.badTier: Give a tier: wood, stone, iron or diamond.
